page: Google Cloud Platform c4n-highmem-24-lssd is a memory-optimized server instance belonging to the c4n family. It features 24 dedicated vCPUs built on the x86_64 architecture, paired with 186.0 GB of system memory. This configuration provides a resource density of 7.75 GB of RAM per core, supporting memory-intensive operations without GPU acceleration.

The instance includes bundled local storage consisting of four NVMe SSDs, delivering a total capacity of 1611 GB. This high-speed local storage is integrated directly into the hardware profile, offering low-latency data access. The server does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the c4n-highmem-24-lssd balances dedicated compute resources with a high memory-to-core ratio and integrated high-speed local storage. This makes the server suitable for workloads such as databases, memory-intensive data processing, and applications requiring fast local scratch space.
